findings.summary: gh_api has no --max-time bound, unlike gitea_api which got 60s/1800s ceilings.
findings.mechanism: The task explicitly calls for bounding how long any single request can run, and gitea_api was updated with --max-time, but gh_api (used in the paginated enumeration loop) was left with no timeout at all. A stalled/hung connection to api.github.com will block the script indefinitely despite the stated resilience goal.
